'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Casey Anis DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Casey Anis]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Invasion Tanks v1.3
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
